headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: 174 United flights are in the air right now, 73% fewer than the median of 651 at this hour over the past 7 days.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 11:59 PM PT, because of wind. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 138 minutes and up to 690 minutes.

Weather is affecting operations at Newark (EWR): somewhat low clouds or visibility and rain, which can cause minor delays. Los Angeles (LAX) is the lowest hub on time, with 73% of departures within 30 minutes of schedule (52 departed).

Outside the hubs, the FAA has a ground stop for flights into Toronto (YYZ) until 6:15 PM ET and rates the chance of an extension as high. It also has ground delay programs for flights into Boston, LaGuardia and San Diego.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport; the same applies to Toronto, Boston, LaGuardia and San Diego.
